data.name: Change Shape
data.description: An aerieborn skinwalker can change shape to a bestial form as a standard action. In bestial form, an aerieborn skinwalker gains a +2 racial bonus to Dexterity. While in this form, a skinwalker also takes on an animalistic feature that provides a special effect. Each time an aerieborn skinwalker assumes bestial form, he can choose to gain a bite attack that deals 1d6 points of damage, 2 talon attacks that each deal 1d4 points of damage, +4 racial bonus on Perception checks, or increase fly speeds from other sources by 10 feet. These benefits last until the skinwalker returns to his humanoid form as a swift action. A skinwalker must first return to his humanoid form before changing to bestial form again to change benefits.
